notes.title: Patch #5
notes.content:
You can now press Shift+H to hide the entire interface mid-game—and snap those beautiful screenshots!
To bring the interface and text back, simply press Shift+H again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/e601a0f11c65d48f381a1e18c4485e6ee587d569.png[/img]

Minor fixes:
[list]
[*] Tony’s cracks no longer multiply at their own discretion
[*] In the old town library, points of interest do not overlap with the diary icon anymore
[*] Candy has gotten a grip and now brings over cookies less often
[*] From now on, unstabilised areas will look less stabilised at the police station when Iris is downstairs alone
[/list]
We’re elbows deep in that sound overhaul, and it’s shaping up great! =)

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
We’ve added an “Extra QTE time” option to the settings: it gives you x300 more time to complete each QTE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/d6a2e058b445facb74518e291d51c44045a74f5a.png[/img]

After some thorough consideration, we decided against introducing an auto-skip for QTEs: there are situations in the game when you need to make a choice under a time constraint, and we wouldn’t want to make that choice for you. =)) But the time extension should do!

Minor fixes:
[list]
[*] Iris now handles her glass of whisky more carefully
[*] Iris and Johnny now enjoy a few snacks as they drink the whisky
[*] Dora no longer tries to teleport the player to previously visited bus stops
[/list]
We continue working on the sound overhaul, gradually adding new musical themes for the characters, and we’re considering introducing a photo mode, too.

That doesn’t mean we forgot about the QTEs: making them easier to complete is in progress, too ))

[*] The cat no longer levitates
[*] Maximilian has been rescued from behind the textures. To the contrary, we hid Leo somewhat

[*] Johnny has agreed to carry Iris into the void only once per playthrough (took some convincing, though)
[*] Dora now listens to Iris with greater attention in the forest
[/list]

notes.title: Enhanced UI, Bug Fixes, and Improved Performance!
notes.content:
[h3]Here’s what’s new:[/h3]

[b]Updated User Interface[/b]: We’ve listened to your feedback and implemented accidental skip protections. 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Say goodbye to those pesky bugs! We've specifically addressed the issue causing a block when using the rollback feature. 

[b]Performance Upgrades[/b]: Players using embedded GPUs will notice a significant boost in performance. We’ve optimized the game to ensure a more fluid experience across various hardware setups.

Your experience matters to us, and we're committed to continuous improvement. As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Feel free to drop a comment, or reach out through our community forums or support.

Thank you for your support and for being part of our community!

tags.feature: We’ve listened to your feedback and implemented accidental skip protections.

tags.bug: We've specifically addressed the issue causing a block when using the rollback feature.
